name: cua-rdp
description: Run cua-driver inside a native Windows RDP Child Session: a Child Desktop panel starts and connects the isolated desktop, and the session agent operates it through the desktop_* MCP tools without touching the parent desktop.

description_i18n.en: Run cua-driver inside a native Windows RDP Child Session: a Child Desktop panel starts and connects the isolated desktop, and the session agent operates it through the desktop_* MCP tools without touching the parent desktop.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 在原生 Windows RDP 子会话中运行 cua-driver：通过“子桌面”面板启动并连接隔离桌面，会话内的 agent 使用 desktop_* MCP 工具接管操作，父桌面不受任何输入干扰。
